terminal.purpose: Command output, user input, and target identity where alignment matters.

label.purpose: Compact tab, target, and connection-state copy.

motion.name: fit-retry
motion.value: requestAnimationFrame for up to 2s during initial layout settling
motion.purpose: Keep xterm dimensions accurate without animating the terminal surface.

components.name: Terminal Canvas
components.description: Full-screen xterm surface for direct or application sessions.

components.name: Terminal Sidebar
components.description: Direct Terminal session list and add-session control.
components.css: .ds-terminal-sidebar { width: 200px; min-height: 100%; background: #1a1a1a; color: #fff; } .ds-sidebar-add, .ds-terminal-tab { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,.9); background: transparent; text-align: left; font: 400 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar-add { height: 50px; border-bottom: 2px solid #232528; } .ds-sidebar-add:hover, .ds-terminal-tab:hover { background: #232323; } .ds-terminal-tab:focus-visible, .ds-sidebar-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bfbfbf; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Recovery Button
components.description: Retry or reconnect action shown after a failed or ended session.
components.css: .ds-recovery-button { padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #1a1a1a; font: 400 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-recovery-button:hover { background: #bfbfbf; } .ds-recovery-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A full-screen operational work surface. Dark tonal layers keep attention on command output while compact labels and explicit recovery states explain what the session is doing.

rules.name: The Shell Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce competing decorative accents on the terminal surface.

rules.name: The Readable Shell Rule
rules.body: Keep terminal output monospace and at least 14px.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layers and state overlays instead of decorative shadows.

dos: Do keep the terminal canvas full-screen.
donts: Don't use ornamental gradients or broad soft shadows.
